title: 世界需要更多的英雄 / The World Could Always Use More Heroes

vo.zh: 致每一个，回应召唤的人。
vo.en: To everyone who answers the call.

vo.zh: 我们曾经以为，英雄的时代，已经结束了。
vo.en: We once believed the age of heroes was over.

vo.zh: 直到那一天，信号再次亮起。
vo.en: Until the day the signal lit up again.

vo.zh: 它飞越海洋与城市，去寻找每一个，还没有放弃的人。
vo.en: It crossed oceans and cities, searching for everyone who hadn't given up.

vo.zh: 伦敦的雨夜里，有人为陌生人，撑起了一把伞。
vo.en: On a rainy night in London, someone held an umbrella over a stranger.

vo.zh: 在花村，分离多年的兄弟，终于再次并肩。
vo.en: In Hanamura, brothers divided for years stood side by side once more.

vo.zh: 在努巴尼，一个女孩亲手造出了，守护这座城市的朋友。
vo.en: In Numbani, a girl built a friend with her own hands to guard her city.

vo.zh: 在釜山，最年轻的战士，守护着她的家乡。
vo.en: In Busan, the youngest soldier stood guard over her home.

vo.zh: 有人从天而降，只为扶起每一个倒下的人。
vo.en: Someone descended from the sky, only to lift up everyone who fell.

vo.zh: 有人在群山之巅，寻找人与智械之间的和平。
vo.en: Someone sought peace between humans and omnics atop the mountains.

vo.zh: 在漓江塔，万家灯火，为每一个归来的人而亮。
vo.en: At Lijiang Tower, ten thousand lights shone for everyone coming home.

vo.zh: 有人在月球上仰望地球；有人在火星上，梦见了它。
vo.en: One looked up at Earth from the Moon. Another dreamed of it on Mars.

vo.zh: 可是黑暗，总会再来。
vo.en: But the darkness always returns.

vo.zh: 而这一次，我们不再孤单。
vo.en: And this time, we are not alone.

vo.zh: 老兵，为新人举起盾牌。
vo.en: The veterans raise their shields for the new.

vo.zh: 新人，为老兵守住防线。
vo.en: The new hold the line for the veterans.

vo.zh: 英雄，从来都不是一个人。
vo.en: A hero was never just one person.

vo.zh: 是每一只伸出的手，是每一个，不愿放弃的你。
vo.en: It's every hand held out. It's every one of you who refused to give up.

vo.zh: 这个世界，永远需要更多的英雄。
vo.en: The world could always use more heroes.

vo.zh: 现在，轮到你了。
vo.en: Now, it's your turn.
